page.layout: Top of page: running head "DE COENA DOMINI." with page number 136 at top left. Full-width text above the columns (continuing paragraphs with side notes in the right margin). Below: two columns of text, left column headed LXXVIII. and right column continuing with notes marked by a marginal "Matth." reference; left margin holds the marginal running label "Dominica 29." and a section number.

main_text.p: guinem,& fparfit fuper populum, & dixit, En fanguis fœderis quod pepigit Dominus vobifcum fuper omnibus rebus illis.
Heb.9. v.20. Hic eft fanguis Teftamenti, quod mandauit vobis Deus.
{c} Exod.13. v.9. Et erit tibi in fignum fuper manum tuam, & in memoriale inter oculos tuos, vt fit Lex Domini in ore tuo, quia in manu forti eduxit te Dominus ex Aegypto.

{a} 1. Cor.10.v.16.17. Poculum benedictionis cui benedicimus, nonne communio fanguinis Chrifti eft? panis quem frangimus, nonne communio corporis Chrifti eft? Quoniam vnus panis, vnum corpus multi fumus: nam omnes vnius panis participes fimus.
main_text.head: LXXVIII.
Num ergo panis & vinum fiunt ipfum corpus & fanguis Chrifti?
main_text.p: Nequaquam: Verum, vt aqua Baptifmi in fanguinem Chrifti non conuertitur, nec eft ipfa peccatorum ablutio
{a} Matth.26.v.29. Dico autem vobis, non bibam ab hoc tempore ex hoc fructu vitis, vfque ad diem illu quum ipfum bibam vobifcum nouum in regno Patris mei.

page.notes: Marginal label "Dominica 29." at left; catchword/line "tio" at foot of right column; the page is a 16th-century Latin devotional text with some printing faults and smudged edges; the letter marks {a}, {c} are reconstructed from the printed daggers and may be inexact.
